Build notes

How the top of the product page works. Open it on a phone, or narrow the browser window. Marie shows a style with 76 colours, Britt a style with 4.

  1. Order on phones: photo, then name, price, star rating and fit cues, then colour, leg length, size, fit advice, Add to basket, delivery date, returns and phone number. On desktop the gallery sits on the left and the buy box on the right.
  2. More than 12 colours: show colour families, using the colour group already in Graphene. Order families by units sold. Each family shows its best-selling colour in the chosen size, with a shade count. Tapping a family opens its shades, with "N more not in your size". A "Show all colours" link shows every swatch.
  3. 12 colours or fewer: named swatches, no families.
  4. Size stays chosen when the colour or length changes. Sizes not in stock in that colour are crossed out and can't be picked. Colours not in the chosen size are hidden, with a count of how many.
  5. Only the sizes the style comes in are shown.
  6. Leg length: buttons with inches and cm where a style has more than one length, and plain text where it has one.
  7. Each colour has its own photos. The main photo and thumbnails change with the colour.
  8. Fit advice next to the sizes, from a field per style, with the phone number. Marie: "a generous fit, try a size smaller".
  9. Arrival date under Add to basket, worked out from the shop's own dispatch and delivery times, with the 1pm next working day cut-off.
  10. Add to basket bar stays pinned to the bottom on phones once the main button scrolls off screen.
  11. Remove the "All images are copyright protected" bar under the gallery.

Product reviews with a fit summary are a separate piece of work and aren't in this file.
